channel.title: The Greenville Advocate - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Greenville Advocate (greenvilleadvocate.com)

item.title: Butler County Arrests Jan. 26 - Feb. 1
item.description: Butler County reports arrests from Jan. 26 – Feb. 1, with charges including drug possession, DUI, domestic violence, theft, reckless endangerment, fugitive from justice and organized retail theft.

item.title: Council reviews finances, city operations
item.description: Greenville council trims college funding as tax collections boost cash flow, prepares for Camellia Gras and weighs hospital sale in bid to tighten city operations.

item.title: Butler County Upcoming Events
item.description: From live jazz and an MLK Freedom March to Camellia Gras, Kids’ Camellia Show and weekly clubs, explore upcoming Butler County events and activities this February.

item.title: McKenzie Student wins county spelling bee
item.description: McKenzie student Andi H. wins Butler County Spelling Bee and will represent the county at the State Spelling Bee on March 16.

item.title: Of choir robes and swing sets
item.description: A pastor recalls turning down choir robes and a playground request, and how those choices reshaped his view of church priorities, compromise and keeping focus on ministry.

item.title: The holy season of Lent
item.description: As Ash Wednesday on Feb. 18 begins Lent’s 40 days of prayer and repentance, local Methodist churches invite all to reflect, fast and seek deeper faith.

item.title: Book club hosts sibling authors' luncheon
item.description: The Three L Book Club hosts sibling authors Julia Walker and Norman McMillan for a luncheon on memoir, family stories and the real-life experiences behind Fireball and Distant Son.

item.title: How do I fit in?
item.description: A minister reflects on how preaching, marriage and following Christ answered his search for where he fits in — and why Solomon’s quest for meaning still matters today.

item.title: You do not face adversity alone
item.description: From NFL stars to Jesus’ first disciples, this reflection shows how faith in the crucified Christ turns fear and adversity into courage — and reminds you that you never face trials alone.

item.title: Camellia Society to host Kids Camellia Show
item.description: Greenville Camellia Society hosts Feb. 21 Kids Camellia Show at Beeland Park, with youth camellia bloom contest, art expo, music showcase and cash prizes.
